sql:
SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    sum(s.TotalCost) AS total_cogs,
    avg(i.OnHandQuantity * i.UnitCost) AS avg_inventory_value,
    if(avg_inventory_value > 0, total_cogs / avg_inventory_value, NULL) AS inventory_turnover_ratio
FROM retail.FactSales AS s
JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        OnHandQuantity,
        UnitCost
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
) AS i ON s.ProductKey = i.ProductKey
WHERE toYear(s.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY p.ProductKey, p.ProductName
ORDER BY inventory_turnover_ratio DESC
